snippet.title: Artificial Selection — Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Artificial Selection is a mystery visual novel with escape game/puzzle sequences and optional romance!

🌃 Play the Beta: https://ko-fi.com/post/Beta-Access-for-Artificial-Selection-Z8Z7KCHSV

🌃 Play the free Demo:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection
Itch.io: https://kigyo.itch.io/artificial-selection

🌃 Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S

🌃 Story:
Saeva, a socially anxious teenager, finds himself trapped in a building along with 13 other young adults. They are all accused of being criminals and are told the only way to escape is by proving their worth and potential for improvement.

Saeva is fairly confident he's innocent, but can the same be said about everyone else?

🌃 Features:
- There are 14 hot singles in your confined area!
Dive deep into the psychology and philosophy of 14 different (supposed) criminals! Who knows, you might grow closer to them than expected...

- Solve escape room puzzles!
Exercise your brain and build a sense of solidarity with the other participants by overcoming various tasks together.

- Prove your debate skills!
The majority decides who gets left behind, so it's up to you to convince them who that is. Change the tides of a debate by strategically attacking or defending the right opponents.

- A highly complex flowchart!
Keep track of affection opportunities you might have missed, and jump back and forth between branching paths with ease.

- Bisexual lighting!
A heavily stylized blue, pink and purple environment surrounds you every step of the way. Heaps of customization options allow you to adjust the game's look to your liking.
